now.title: Eternals
now.text: Arishem plants Celestial seeds in planets, but the Eternals turn Tiamut to stone before he can emerge from Earth.

proposed.text: Arishem plants Celestial seeds in planets, and the Eternals turn Tiamut to stone as his head and hand rise out of the ocean.

changes.evidence: In Eternals, Tiamut is not stopped before emerging: parts of his head and left hand rise out of the Indian Ocean before Sersi, powered by the Uni-Mind, turns him to stone mid-emergence.
